judged_text: No test saves a host with a port and then checks host_allowed?, which would expose the port-matching bug

record.issue_text: No test saves a host with a port and then checks host_allowed?, which would expose the port-matching bug

adjudication.rationale: EmbeddableHost allows saving hosts with a port (validation regex permits `(:[0-9]{1,5})?`), but `before_validation` only strips scheme and path, not the port (`self.host.sub!(...); self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`). Later, `record_for_host` parses a full URL/referer via `URI(host)` and uses `uri.host`, which excludes the port, then queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. If the DB stored `example.com:3000`, lookup for referer `http://example.com:3000/...` will query for `example.com` and fail, so `host_allowed?` incorrectly returns false. Existing tests cover scheme/path trimming and host_allowed? for plain hosts, but none cover the port case, so the bug would not be caught.
